title: Boss Parfums inks multi-year partnership with Hyrox across six European regions
summary: The multi-year partnership between Coty-owned Boss Parfums and fitness racing series Hyrox will unfold across six European regions as the fragrance brand becomes part of ‘the Hyrox ecosystem’
